purpose: Deterministic account-accounting contract for S2 V2 Monthly Target; no UI formulas are authoritative.

precision.fund_shares: high precision internally; product rule at settlement

state.R: ReserveCash: excluded permanently from S2 until typed internal transfer R_TO_PENDING
state.Payable: recognized obligation, subtracted from total wealth
state.NAV_HWM: highest pre-fee NAV evaluated at a completed monthly execution

identity: TotalWealth = F + C + R + sum(open Pending lots) + sum(open Unsettled assets) - Payable
investable_assets_before_trade: F + C after merging only frozen eligible pending lots; R, ineligible pending, subscription pending and redemption receivable are excluded.

cutoff.signal: month-end trading day T close, independent of account balances
cutoff.eligible: cleared_at <= cutoff AND eligible_batch_id == current batch; frozen at cutoff
cutoff.late_funds: cleared after cutoff receive the next batch id and cannot enter the frozen batch

idempotency: Every external contribution, withdrawal and system event has immutable unique event_id. Replayed id returns ALREADY_PROCESSED and never changes state.

external_flows.contribution: D > 0: add a pending lot and Units += D/NAV_before. Record only once when ownership of money enters account.
external_flows.withdrawal: W > 0 and W <= withdrawable assets; Units -= paid_amount/NAV_before at the actual external-payment time. Rejected otherwise.
external_flows.non_rebalance: A non-monthly withdrawal raises only W plus required fee; it never targets S2 exposure.

monthly_order: Process cleared external flows and units through cutoff.
Merge eligible lots P -> C once.
Transfer lock from active domain to Reserve domain.
Compute active investable assets after lock.
Read frozen market-only S2 exposure p.
Execute exactly one net fund trade and create settlement lots.
Update state, NAV/HWM and audit log.

profit_lock.formula: max(0, NAV_prelock - NAV_HWM) * Units * lock_ratio + deferred_profit_lock
profit_lock.hwm_update: NAV_HWM = max(NAV_HWM, NAV_prelock), before trade fees; this prevents re-locking the identical pre-fee profit band. Fees remain a genuine NAV drawdown.
profit_lock.units: ProfitLock is an internal transfer; it creates neither Units nor XIRR flow.
profit_lock.liquidity: Use C first; if required, fund the reserve via the same monthly net sale. Never create a separate round-trip trade. If the requested lock would make sale fees infeasible, execute the maximum fee-feasible amount and retain the remainder as deferred_profit_lock.

settlement.subscription: C -> PENDING_SUBSCRIPTION; it remains in TotalWealth but is not AvailableCash or confirmed F until settlement.
settlement.redemption: F -> REDEMPTION_RECEIVABLE net of fee; receivable counts once in TotalWealth and cannot be spent before availability.
settlement.availability: Settlement moves receivable to C/R or pays a withdrawal. The same asset is never simultaneously F and receivable/cash.

returns.TWR: NAV / initial_NAV - 1; external flows change units rather than NAV.
returns.XIRR: initial/additional contributions negative; cash actually outside the account positive; terminal F+C+R+P+U-Payable positive. Pending, reserve and ProfitLock are internal.

dividends.TOTAL_RETURN_EMBEDDED: Block standalone cash dividends to prevent double counting.
dividends.PRICE_PLUS_CASH: REINVEST/STRATEGY_CASH/PENDING/RESERVE are internal income; only distribution outside is an external withdrawal. Dividends are never external contributions.
